options: A scaled-down version of a data warehouse, focused on one specific business function or department
A backup copy of the entire data warehouse
A tool for entering new transactional data
A synonym for a data lake with no real difference
questions.explain: A mart narrows a warehouse's broad, organization-wide scope down to one team's actual needs.

questions.q: What is a dependent data mart?
options: A mart carved out of an existing data warehouse, built from the warehouse's already-integrated data
A mart that can only be queried by one specific user
A mart that automatically deletes itself after 30 days
A mart built with no relationship to any other data source
questions.explain: Dependent marts inherit the warehouse's integration and consistency work, rather than redoing it.

questions.q: What is an independent data mart?
options: A mart built standalone, loaded directly from source systems without going through a central warehouse first
A mart that requires no source data at all
A mart that only exists inside AdventureWorksDW2014
A mart that can never be updated
questions.explain: Independent marts are faster to stand up but don't share a central warehouse's integration work.

questions.q: How do FactInternetSales and FactResellerSales in AdventureWorksDW2014 illustrate the data mart concept?
options: Each represents a distinct sales channel that a focused team could query as its own mart, without needing the other channel's data
They are actually the exact same table with two different names
They demonstrate that data marts cannot coexist with a data warehouse
They are examples of OLTP tables, not warehouse tables
questions.explain: A reseller-operations team querying just FactResellerSales is functionally using a dependent-mart-style slice of the warehouse.

questions.q: Why would a team want a data mart instead of querying the full data warehouse directly?
options: It trims the warehouse down to exactly what one team needs, avoiding dozens of irrelevant tables and resource contention with other teams' queries
Marts are required by SQL Server before any warehouse can be created
Querying a warehouse directly is technically impossible
Marts contain more data than the warehouse they come from
questions.explain: A mart is a faster, simpler, more focused surface built on top of or alongside the same underlying data.
